propositions: /rerun and recheck-review acceptance requests exist only in the process-local asyncio queue and are lost on process restart before being processed, even when Gerrit retains the old nonzero vote and SQLite retains a matching voted row
Reconciliation checks local dedup state before querying Gerrit, causing it to skip revisions whose stale dedup rows survive after a Gerrit vote is reset

The approved contract requires reset of the exact revision to neutral LLM-Review:0 before acceptance acknowledgement, with the resulting comment-added event serving as the durable owed-review marker across process loss
Accepted requests must perform reset+verify+budget-reset+enqueue atomically in that order, with the Gerrit read verifying no surviving nonzero vote and returning fail-closed if verification fails

Reconciliation must query Gerrit first and clear only the exact matching stale dedup row on successful no-nonzero-vote verification before invoking the voter, while Gerrit read errors preserve dedup and hold the cursor back

Contributor-provided text cannot influence label values or mint affirmative/refusal decisions; only privileged reset operations write the fixed neutral 0, and replies remain label-free via post_comment
